howto.goal: Send a champion into the arena with a strategy card. The card decides the whole battle, and the fight replays exactly from its seed.
howto.setup: Your champion against a house champion, or four champions in a free-for-all. A strategy card sets how your champion fights. No model is called while the tanks fight.

sections.title: Champions
sections.text: Each champion has its own strength and habits.

sections.title: Strategy card
sections.text: The card decides the whole battle up front. You watch it play out, and it can be replayed exactly.

sections.title: Replays
sections.text: Every fight has a seed, so the same seed always produces the same fight. Nothing is random after the fact.

controls: Press Fight to send your champion against a house champion.
Press Four-way to send it against three house champions.
Press Replay to watch the same fight again from its seed.

demo.intro: An arena fight in four beats.

frames.say: Each seat gets a strategy card.
The battle plays out from its seed, turn by turn.
The last champion standing takes the arena.

demo.outro: Same seed, same fight: try a different card and replay it to compare.

steps.say: Check your saved card — it decides the whole battle.
Press Fight to send your champion into the arena.
Watch the fight; nothing is decided by chance after the seed.
Press Replay to see the same fight again.
